ideas.title: Neon Demon Hunter
ideas.blurb: Streetwear with glowing sigils, a foam sword, and pop-idol hair and makeup.
ideas.why: Pop star by day, demon hunter by night. The year's biggest costume energy.

ideas.title: Classic Ghost
ideas.blurb: A white sheet with cut-out eyes.
ideas.why: Top five for kids and adults alike. The most universal costume there is.

ideas.title: Aussie Dog Family
ideas.blurb: Dog-ear headbands and blue-or-orange shirts: mama, dad, and the pups.
ideas.why: Blue and orange shirts, paper ears, and your kid completely loses it.

ideas.title: Superhero Family
ideas.blurb: Red sweatsuits, black eye masks, felt logo. The whole family goes super.
ideas.why: Scales from two to six people, and every age knows the movie.

ideas.title: Blue Alien Ohana
ideas.blurb: A blue hoodie and an antenna headband turn the kid into the alien.
ideas.why: Everyone knows the alien without you saying a word, and the headband does all the work.

ideas.title: Emerald Witch
ideas.blurb: An all-green-everything gown, dramatic makeup, and a pointy hat gone couture.
ideas.why: Green is the color of the season, and you can thrift most of it.

ideas.title: Gloom & Bloom
ideas.blurb: Braids and black for Gloom, color-pop and smiles for Bloom.
ideas.why: The deadpan duo: one broods, one sparkles, both nail it.

ideas.title: Deadpan Diva
ideas.blurb: Black dress, two braids, pale makeup, and a stare that ends conversations.
ideas.why: The goth icon: closet-easy, instantly readable, and the braids do half the work.

ideas.title: Safari / Zoo Crew
ideas.blurb: Everyone picks an animal: closet clothes in matching colors plus an ear headband.
ideas.why: One ear pack covers the whole group, and everyone still gets their own role.

ideas.title: Fairy Tale Princesses
ideas.blurb: A dress or a crown from the closet. Every princess works.
ideas.why: Most kids already have a favorite; the dress does the work.

ideas.title: The Tin Hero
ideas.blurb: Red and gold plus a glowing chest circle: the suit does the talking.
ideas.why: Kids lose their minds over the chest light, and the build is mostly a red shirt plus tape.

ideas.title: Good Witch, Bad Witch
ideas.blurb: Green face paint and black for one, pink gown and crown for the other.
ideas.why: The duo of the year: one goes dark, one goes dazzling.

ideas.title: Fuzzy Monster
ideas.blurb: A pastel fuzzy sweatsuit with giant googly eyes and an oversized stitched smile.
ideas.why: Ugly-cute is the whole point, and it is basically pajamas.

ideas.title: Pocket Plush Monster
ideas.blurb: A fuzzy one-piece, giant ears, a stitched smile, and an oversized collector tag.
ideas.why: You become the toy-aisle icon: ugly-cute, comfy, and built for hugs.

ideas.title: Soccer Squad
ideas.blurb: Jerseys for the players, black for the ref, one red card.
ideas.why: World Cup year: everyone already owns half of this.

ideas.title: Glow Skeleton
ideas.blurb: Black sweats with glow-in-the-dark bone tape, plus glow bracelets.
ideas.why: Spooky after dark and visible to cars, which parents love.

ideas.title: Block Game Crew
ideas.blurb: Cardboard-box heads: pick your blocky hero.
ideas.why: A box, some paint, and instant blockhead status.

ideas.title: Web Hero Crew
ideas.blurb: Red, black, and pink hoodies plus masks. Pick your spider.
ideas.why: Everyone gets their own color and nobody fights over it.

ideas.title: Mermaid Crew
ideas.blurb: The mermaid, the prince, the sea king, the sea witch, or the crab: pick your role.
ideas.why: No filler roles in this crew: even the crab gets to be the star.

ideas.title: Little Pig Family
ideas.blurb: Pink clothes and a snout headband; little brother brings the dinosaur.
ideas.why: Four matching snouts in one photo never miss, and little brother's dinosaur is the plot twist.

ideas.title: Enchanted Castle Crew
ideas.blurb: The bookish princess, the cursed prince, the talking candelabra, the talking clock, the talking teapot: pick your role.
ideas.why: The enchanted objects steal the show, and they're all DIY.

ideas.title: Bumble Bee
ideas.blurb: Black sweats with yellow tape stripes and soft felt antennae.
ideas.why: Yellow tape stripes read as bee instantly, and it builds the night before.

ideas.title: Baby Dinosaur
ideas.blurb: Green hoodie, felt spikes down the back, stuffed tail.
ideas.why: A hoodie costume means zero complaints about itching or slipping.

ideas.title: Little Lion
ideas.blurb: Tan sweatsuit plus a fuzzy mane hood.
ideas.why: Head to toe warm, and the mane hood photographs perfectly.

ideas.title: Tiny Firefighter
ideas.blurb: Red sweats, a plastic helmet, and a toy hose.
ideas.why: The helmet does all the work, and other 3-year-olds will wave at yours.

ideas.title: Little Shark
ideas.blurb: Gray hoodie with a felt fin glued on the back.
ideas.why: Sharks are timeless even when the song is not, and it is just a hoodie with a fin.

ideas.title: Walking Taco
ideas.blurb: Tan vest painted like a taco shell with felt toppings.
ideas.why: Wins the preschool parade on laughs alone.

ideas.title: Ramen Bowl
ideas.blurb: Cardboard bowl rim, noodle-yarn hair, a foam egg on top.
ideas.why: Cozy, funny, and the chopsticks make every photo.

ideas.title: Tiny Snail
ideas.blurb: Neutral clothes plus a lightweight spiral shell from cardboard worn like a backpack.
ideas.why: Recognizable without anything on the head or face.

ideas.title: Little Witch
ideas.blurb: Black cape, pointy hat, striped tights, green face paint.
ideas.why: Classic, comfortable, and the green face paint keeps it from being just-a-witch.

ideas.title: Eight-Legged Spider
ideas.blurb: Black sweats with stuffed sock legs attached at the sides.
ideas.why: Spooky from across the street, snuggly up close.

ideas.title: Backyard Superhero
ideas.blurb: Short cape plus a first initial on the chest, mask optional.
ideas.why: Skip the mask, add a face-paint lightning bolt, still a hero.

ideas.title: Pickle
ideas.blurb: Green tunic, bumpy texture, smug grin.
ideas.why: A pickle costume has no business working this well. And yet.

ideas.title: Classic Vampire
ideas.blurb: Black cape, fangs, slicked hair.
ideas.why: Scary with 25 minutes of effort and it photographs great.

ideas.title: Bamboo-Muzzle Demon
ideas.blurb: Pink robe, long dark wig, and a cardboard bamboo muzzle tied with ribbon.
ideas.why: Cute demon energy: anime fans clock it instantly, everyone else just sees adorable.

ideas.title: Emoji Crew
ideas.blurb: Everyone picks an emoji: a yellow tee plus a big printed face.
ideas.why: Everyone picks their own emoji, and the group photo reads instantly.

ideas.title: Cardboard Robot Crew
ideas.blurb: Boxy robots built from cardboard boxes, foil, and bottle-cap buttons.
ideas.why: Cardboard boxes scale to any headcount, and every robot looks intentionally janky.

ideas.title: Cereal Crew
ideas.blurb: Solid-color clothes plus a cereal-box front you decorate.
ideas.why: Everyone designs their own box, and the breakfast lineup is adorable.

ideas.title: Decades Crew
ideas.blurb: Each person picks a decade and dresses from their own closet.
ideas.why: Everyone gets their own era, and the decades together look intentional.

ideas.title: Under the Sea
ideas.blurb: Jellyfish from an umbrella with ribbon tentacles, crab from red clothes and claw mittens, plus fish, seaweed, and waves.
ideas.why: The go-all-out family theme; every age can scale their part up or down.

ideas.title: Dino Rangers
ideas.blurb: Khaki outfits for the grown-ups, dino hoods for the kids. Leash a toy raptor.
ideas.why: The kids get to be dinosaurs; that's the whole sell.

ideas.title: Board Game Pieces
ideas.blurb: Each person picks a piece: cardboard die, playing card, pawn, or domino over monochrome clothes.
ideas.why: Everyone recognizes every piece, and the group looks like a set.

ideas.title: Rain Cloud and Rainbow
ideas.blurb: One wears gray with cotton clouds and paper raindrops; the other wears rainbow stripes.
ideas.why: The two costumes clearly belong together without matching outfits.

ideas.title: The Doctor & the Bride
ideas.blurb: Green face paint and neck bolts for one; tall streaked wig and torn gown for the other.
ideas.why: The classic monster duo: scary, easy, and everyone knows who you are.

ideas.title: Breakfast Buffet
ideas.blurb: Everyone picks a breakfast: egg, bacon, toast, pancake, OJ, coffee. Cardboard signs over normal clothes.
ideas.why: Scales to any group size and nobody needs a full costume.

ideas.title: Ghost Hunters
ideas.blurb: Khaki jumpsuits, cardboard ghost-catching backpacks, name patches.
ideas.why: Paranormal investigators for the night. Scare each other all night.

ideas.title: Haunted Animatronics
ideas.blurb: Glitchy mascot heads from cardboard boxes, flickering LED eyes, jerky moves.
ideas.why: Scary-funny in a group, and the photo booth line will find you.

ideas.title: Mystery Crew
ideas.blurb: Assign the leader, the style icon, the brains, the goofball, and one very good dog.
ideas.why: Everyone gets a character and the dog steals the show.

ideas.title: Headless Horsemen
ideas.blurb: Black capes, jack-o-lanterns held at shoulder height, group gallop.
ideas.why: The visual is unreal in photos, and the bit is just walking menacingly together.

ideas.title: Haunted Portraits
ideas.blurb: Gray makeup, old-timey clothes, hold a gilt frame.
ideas.why: Spooky, artsy, and you just stand still.

ideas.title: Goggle Crew
ideas.blurb: Yellow tees, denim overalls, goggles, black gloves.
ideas.why: Group chaos in its purest form, and overalls are just useful.

ideas.title: Garden Gnome
ideas.blurb: Wear earth tones, make a pointy hat from cardboard, draw a white beard, carry a tiny fishing rod or garden shovel.
ideas.why: Big silhouette, tiny fishing rod: the proportions are the whole joke.

ideas.title: Black Cat Burglar
ideas.blurb: Black sweatsuit, cat-ear headband, eye mask. Add a toy sack for burglar.
ideas.why: Warm, easy, and the ears do all the work.

ideas.title: Block Monster
ideas.blurb: Wear all one solid color, square up your silhouette with foam or cardboard blocks on shoulders/limbs, draw a pixelated face.
ideas.why: Video game people recognize it instantly, pure geometry, works at any scale.

ideas.title: Space Crewmate
ideas.blurb: Colored sweatsuit plus a cardboard backpack.
ideas.why: One shopping trip and you're done.

ideas.title: Sun and Moon
ideas.blurb: One in yellow with cardboard rays, one in navy with paper stars and a crescent.
ideas.why: Two faces, one night: simple paint, big charm.

ideas.title: Moth and Porch Light
ideas.blurb: One wears neutrals with cardboard wings; the other wears yellow and carries a lampshade.
ideas.why: The joke lands in one second and it builds in under an hour.

ideas.title: Raptor & Ranger
ideas.blurb: One khaki ranger, one green dino hood. The ranger holds the leash.
ideas.why: Funny from across the parking lot.

ideas.title: Cat & Mouse
ideas.blurb: Cat ears versus mouse ears. Spend the night chasing each other.
ideas.why: Built-in party game, no props beyond the ears.

ideas.title: Ketchup & Mustard
ideas.blurb: Red bottle tunic and cap for one, yellow for the other.
ideas.why: The couple costume everyone recognizes from across the room.

ideas.title: Plumber Duo
ideas.blurb: Overalls, red and green caps and shirts, drawn mustaches.
ideas.why: Matching without being cheesy, and the mustaches do the talking.

ideas.title: Office Couple
ideas.blurb: White shirts, name tags, and a teapot. The office's finest.
ideas.why: Instantly readable, and you can wear it to the office party.

ideas.title: Burger Joint Couple
ideas.blurb: White apron plus fake mustache, curly red wig plus glasses. Burger shop owners.
ideas.why: A couples costume people actually recognize across the room.

ideas.title: Plug and Socket
ideas.blurb: Cardboard plug and outlet worn front and back.
ideas.why: Peak pun-couple energy, built from boxes in an afternoon.

ideas.title: Lost Tourist
ideas.blurb: Wear wrinkled clothes, carry a crumpled map, add one luggage tag backwards on your shoulder.
ideas.why: Relatable, needs only closet pieces, instantly funny to wear.

ideas.title: Tooth and Tooth Fairy
ideas.blurb: One all-white with a cardboard tooth outline; the other adds wings and an envelope of tooth money.
ideas.why: An obvious pair, playful instead of elaborate.

ideas.title: Web Hero Duo
ideas.blurb: Red-blue sweatsuit plus web mask; partner gets the black jacket and attitude.
ideas.why: Classic duo with zero sewing required.

ideas.title: Plague Doctor
ideas.blurb: Long coat, wide hat, beaked mask.
ideas.why: Genuinely unsettling and you get to keep the mask for years.

ideas.title: Crowd Camouflage
ideas.blurb: Gray hoodie, dark pants, blank expression. Vanish into any crowd.
ideas.why: Six of you walk in dressed identically. Nobody knows who arrived with whom.

ideas.title: Error 404
ideas.blurb: Wear all black with a blank white page taped to your chest; carry a phone with a cracked-screen prop.
ideas.why: Instantly readable, tech crowd gets it, non-tech crowd gets it anyway.

ideas.title: Zombie Coworker
ideas.blurb: Torn button-down, loosened tie, pale makeup, coffee mug.
ideas.why: Scary with zero shopping: it's just your work clothes, ruined.

ideas.title: The Olympians
ideas.blurb: Bedsheet togas, gold rope belts, laurel crowns. Pick your god: lightning bolt, owl, or trident.
ideas.why: Greek myth went cinematic again this year, and a bedsheet toga is the most epic thing a bedsheet ever did.

ideas.title: Safari Photographer
ideas.blurb: Khaki vest, toy camera and binoculars, plus a stuffed lion cub under one arm.
ideas.why: The camera does the talking, and the plush cub steals every photo.

ideas.title: Player One & Two
ideas.blurb: Matching tees with 1 and 2, toy controllers in hand, ready for co-op.
ideas.why: Zero sewing, instantly readable, and the controllers are the whole joke.

ideas.title: Dinosaur Family
ideas.blurb: Matching dino-hoodie sweatsuits for the whole crew, spikes down every back.
ideas.why: Matching dino hoodies need zero coordination, and the spikes sell it from far away.

ideas.title: Ice Kingdom Crew
ideas.blurb: The ice queen, the snow princess, the talking snowman, the reindeer: pick your role.
ideas.why: The family costume every kid already knows by heart, and the snowman is basically pajamas.

ideas.title: Sushi Roll
ideas.blurb: A white-sheet wrap with felt salmon and pom-pom wasabi. Chopsticks optional.
ideas.why: It turns bedsheets into the most photogenic thing at the party.

ideas.title: Deviled Egg
ideas.blurb: White shirt with a felt yolk, devil horns, and a red tail. Half egg, half devil.
ideas.why: The yolk-and-horns combo reads from twenty feet away with zero explaining.

ideas.title: Pizza Slice
ideas.blurb: A big cardboard triangle, painted golden with felt pepperoni.
ideas.why: Cardboard and felt become the rare costume kids and adults both reach for.

ideas.title: Popcorn Bucket
ideas.blurb: A striped cardboard-box body with balloon popcorn on top.
ideas.why: The balloon popcorn bounces when they walk, which sells the whole thing.

ideas.title: Ice Cream Cone
ideas.blurb: A tan paper cone hat and a sprinkle-dotted scoop shirt.
ideas.why: A cone hat, a scoop shirt, and sprinkles read as ice cream instantly, no explanation needed.

ideas.title: Peanut Butter & Jelly
ideas.blurb: One in brown with a PB label, one in purple with a J label.
ideas.why: Two solid-color outfits and two labels make the most recognizable duo in the room.

ideas.title: Bacon & Eggs
ideas.blurb: Wavy bacon stripes and a sunny-side-up egg yolk.
ideas.why: The wavy bacon stripes make the pair readable from across the room.

ideas.title: Peas in a Pod
ideas.blurb: Green shirts in a row under one long felt pod sash.
ideas.why: The shared sash turns any group into one costume people actually remember.

ideas.title: Basketball Star
ideas.blurb: Jersey, shorts, eye-black stripes, and a ball that never leaves your hand.
ideas.why: Real gear plus one theatrical touch beats a store-bought uniform.

ideas.title: Referee
ideas.blurb: A striped shirt, a whistle, and a yellow penalty flag.
ideas.why: The whistle gives you a bit to perform instead of just standing around.

ideas.title: Boxer
ideas.blurb: Bathrobe, toy gloves, bruise makeup, and entrance music.
ideas.why: The entrance music does half the work before a single punch is thrown.

ideas.title: Cheerleader
ideas.blurb: Team colors and pom-poms made from cut plastic bags.
ideas.why: Homemade pom-poms and a chant beat a store costume, no contest.

ideas.title: Tennis Duo
ideas.blurb: All-white outfits, headbands, toy rackets, and a tube of balls.
ideas.why: The all-white dress code makes two people look like a team instantly.

ideas.title: Bowling Pins
ideas.blurb: White outfits with red neck stripes, plus one bowler in black.
ideas.why: The bowler-and-pins bit gives the group something to do all night.

ideas.title: Cardboard Knight
ideas.blurb: Silver-painted cardboard armor and a pool-noodle sword.
ideas.why: Spray paint turns moving boxes into armor that looks genuinely cool.

ideas.title: Ninja
ideas.blurb: All black with a belt sash and a slit headband.
ideas.why: One headband turns pajamas into a stealth mission.

ideas.title: Caped Duo
ideas.blurb: Matching sheet capes, felt masks, and your own emblems.
ideas.why: Matching emblems make it yours instead of a store superhero.

ideas.title: Hero Squad
ideas.blurb: Color-coded capes and masks, one team pose for photos.
ideas.why: Color-coded capes make a big group look coordinated with almost no sewing.

ideas.title: Astronaut
ideas.blurb: White sweats, a paper-bag helmet, and a flag patch.
ideas.why: The paper-bag helmet is the whole trick and it actually works.

ideas.title: Robot Ranger
ideas.blurb: Silver boxes, dryer-vent arms, and sticker dials.
ideas.why: Boxes and stickers build a robot that moves and beeps on command.

ideas.title: Penguin Huddle
ideas.blurb: Black shirts, felt bellies, beak headbands. Waddle together.
ideas.why: The group waddle is funnier than any single penguin could be.

ideas.title: Prince & Princess
ideas.blurb: A crown and cape, a thrifted gown and tiara.
ideas.why: Thrifted velvet reads richer than a plastic packaged costume.

ideas.title: Dino Herd
ideas.blurb: Green ponchos with felt spikes and stuffed-sock tails.
ideas.why: A line of stomping dinos gets a bigger reaction than one T-Rex alone.

ideas.title: Pixel Ghost
ideas.blurb: A white sheet cut in chunky pixel squares with felt eyes.
ideas.why: The zigzag pixel edge makes a sheet ghost feel brand new.

ideas.title: Spaghetti & Meatball
ideas.blurb: White shirt with yarn spaghetti glued on, brown pom-pom meatballs.
ideas.why: Dinner you can wear, and the yarn survives the washing machine.

ideas.title: Cupcake
ideas.blurb: Brown tunic for the wrapper, white pillowcase for frosting, cherry on top.
ideas.why: Dessert you can wear, crowned with a cherry.

ideas.title: Banana
ideas.blurb: Yellow sweatsuit with a green felt stem hat.
ideas.why: A single color all over, and the green stem hat makes it read instantly in photos.

ideas.title: Hot Dog
ideas.blurb: Tan foam pool noodle bun, red shirt for the dog, mustard squiggle.
ideas.why: Pool noodles were made for this costume, and you can actually sit down in it.

ideas.title: Donut
ideas.blurb: Pink cardboard ring with sprinkles, worn like a sandwich board.
ideas.why: Cardboard and pink paint, and the sprinkle pattern hides every brush mistake.

ideas.title: Coffee Cup
ideas.blurb: White trash bag over a cardboard tube, brown lid hat.
ideas.why: The cardboard lid hat does the heavy lifting in every photo.

ideas.title: Salt & Pepper
ideas.blurb: White and black outfits with shaker tops made from cardboard.
ideas.why: The couple costume that never misses, and it packs flat for the ride over.

ideas.title: Fruit Salad Crew
ideas.blurb: Each person picks a fruit color, wears it head to toe with a leaf hat.
ideas.why: Everyone picks their own fruit, so nobody argues about who gets to be what.

ideas.title: Classic Wizard
ideas.blurb: Tall black pointy hat, flowing plain black robe, tall straight wooden staff, gray beard optional.
ideas.why: The most recognizable silhouette in Halloween, and nearly all of it comes from a closet plus a craft store run.

ideas.title: Toy Box Crew
ideas.blurb: A cowboy sheriff, a space ranger, and the rest of the toy box: pick your favorite.
ideas.why: The sheriff and the space ranger arguing over who is the favorite toy. Two roles everyone recognizes instantly.

ideas.title: Demon Boy Band
ideas.blurb: Matching streetwear-idol outfits with glowing patterns for your whole boy band.
ideas.why: Matching stage outfits, glowing patterns, and a synchronized dance break. The group photo basically takes itself.

ideas.title: Dragon Rider Duo
ideas.blurb: A viking rider and a cardboard dragon, ready to fly over the neighborhood.
ideas.why: One viking rider, one dragon built from a cardboard box. The dragon gets more compliments than the rider.

ideas.title: Numbered Players
ideas.blurb: Green tracksuits, numbered bibs, and a survival-game attitude.
ideas.why: Green tracksuits and numbered bibs, ready for playground games. The dalgona cookie is the prop people talk about.

ideas.title: Emotion Crew
ideas.blurb: One loud color per person: each of you is a different emotion.
ideas.why: Each person picks an emotion and wears one loud color head to toe. The lineup reads as one big feeling from the doorway.

ideas.title: Kart Racers
ideas.blurb: Cardboard karts and racing caps for a full starting grid of friends.
ideas.why: Your crew lined up like a starting grid, engines revving with mouth sounds. The build fits in one afternoon.

ideas.title: Tall Hat Crew
ideas.blurb: A striped stovepipe hat, a bow tie, and two wild blue-haired Things.
ideas.why: The striped hat does most of the work. The Things just need blue wigs, red suits, and permission to cause trouble.

ideas.title: Chipmunk Trio
ideas.blurb: Letter sweaters, felt ears, and whiskers for a singing trio of chipmunks.
ideas.why: Sweaters with big letters, felt ears, and drawn whiskers. The three-part harmony is optional but encouraged.

ideas.title: Galaxy Knights
ideas.blurb: Robes, belts, and toy energy blades for knights of a far-off galaxy.
ideas.why: Robe, belt, and a toy energy blade. Two stances and the photo looks like a movie poster.

ideas.title: Plastic Dream Crew
ideas.blurb: Head-to-toe pink outfits with plastic accessories for the dream crew.
ideas.why: All pink, head to toe, no notes. The matching sunglasses turn four friends into one unmistakable photo.

ideas.title: Extinct Party Animal
ideas.blurb: Felt dino spikes on a normal jacket, plus a party hat and a badge that reads Last seen 66 million years ago.
ideas.why: A punchline you wear: the extinct-for-66-million-years badge gets the laugh before you say a word.

ideas.title: Dino Tourist
ideas.blurb: Hawaiian shirt, dino tail, camera around your neck, and a fanny pack. The meteor missed this one.
ideas.why: A dinosaur on vacation is inherently ridiculous, and the fanny pack sells it.

ideas.title: Raptor Barista
ideas.blurb: Green hoodie with a dino snout hood, tiny T. rex arms strapped on, and a coffee cup you can barely hold.
ideas.why: The tiny arms are the whole bit: watching a raptor struggle with a latte never gets old.

ideas.title: Emotional Support Dinosaur
ideas.blurb: Dino-spike vest over normal clothes with a badge that says Emotional Support Dinosaur. Do not pet.
ideas.why: The vest turns a known internet joke into a costume, and strangers will read it out loud all night.

ideas.title: Garden Fairy
ideas.blurb: Tulle wings, a flower crown, and a wand: the backyard turns into a fairy tale.
ideas.why: She picks the wing color, and the wand is just a stick with a star on it.

ideas.title: Ballerina
ideas.blurb: A tulle tutu tied onto elastic, a leotard, and a neat ballerina bun.
ideas.why: The tutu needs no sewing, and the twirl does the rest.

ideas.title: Butterfly
ideas.blurb: Painted cardboard wings on black sweats: the garden's prettiest visitor.
ideas.why: The wings fold flat for the car ride and open wide for photos.

ideas.title: Pop Star
ideas.blurb: A sparkly jacket, a toy microphone, and the biggest hair in the room.
ideas.why: Hand her the mic and the living room becomes a stadium.

ideas.title: Ice Skater
ideas.blurb: A white dress, tights, and a perfect bun: gold-medal energy, no ice required.
ideas.why: The bun and the spin sell it; the dress can come straight from the closet.

ideas.title: Ladybug
ideas.blurb: Red sweats, black felt dots, and little spotted wings.
ideas.why: Felt circles do all the work, and it is warm enough for a real October night.

ideas.title: Daisy
ideas.blurb: A yellow petal headband and a green dress: a walking flower.
ideas.why: The petals are craft foam, and she chooses the middle color herself.

ideas.title: Little Baker
ideas.blurb: A paper chef hat, an apron, and a toy whisk.
ideas.why: The hat is one paper circle away, and the whisk doubles as a wand.

ideas.title: Little Artist
ideas.blurb: A beret, a cardboard paint palette, and a splatter-painted smock.
ideas.why: The messier the smock looks, the more convincing the artist.

ideas.title: Beekeeper & Bee
ideas.blurb: One goes as the beekeeper in white with a mesh veil; the other wears yellow and black stripes with antennae.
ideas.why: The veil sells the beekeeper, the stripes sell the bee, and together they read in a single glance.

ideas.title: Block Party Duo
ideas.blurb: Two interlocking tetromino shapes built from painted cardboard boxes, worn like sandwich boards.
ideas.why: You click together for every photo, and strangers will try to name your pieces.

ideas.title: Little Lifeguard
ideas.blurb: Red tee, whistle, and a rescue buoy made from a pool noodle ring: an everyday hero costume.
ideas.why: The whistle is real, the buoy is a pool noodle, and the whole thing reads official at a glance.

ideas.title: Little Prince
ideas.blurb: Crown, cape, and a royal sash from the dress-up box or the craft drawer.
ideas.why: Every prince costume is a crown away from done, and the crooked crown is the whole charm.

ideas.title: Fossil Hunter
ideas.blurb: Khaki vest, toy brush, magnifying glass, and cardboard fossil bones in a belt pouch.
ideas.why: The fossil bones look dug up and real, and the magnifying glass gives their hands something to do between photos.

ideas.title: Web Hero
ideas.blurb: Red sweatsuit, tape web lines, big white eye lenses.
ideas.why: Ten minutes of tape webs on a red sweatsuit reads hero from across the street.

ideas.title: Milk & Cookies
ideas.blurb: White carton tunic for one, brown cookie with felt chips for the other.
ideas.why: Sweet without trying too hard, and the cookie costume photographs great.

ideas.title: Chips & Guac
ideas.blurb: Green guac tunic with red tomato dots for one, giant triangle chip hat for the other.
ideas.why: The party snack everyone fights over, now as a couples costume.

ideas.title: Sushi & Soy Sauce
ideas.blurb: White rice tunic with orange fish sash for one, dark soy bottle for the other.
ideas.why: Clean, clever, and instantly readable from across the bar.

ideas.title: Burger & Fries
ideas.blurb: Sesame-seed bun top for one, red fry carton with yellow fry sticks for the other.
ideas.why: Fast food royalty, and the fry carton doubles as a candy holder.

ideas.title: Donut & Coffee
ideas.blurb: Pink frosted ring tunic for one, takeout coffee cup for the other.
ideas.why: The breakfast date look, built for couples who run on caffeine.

ideas.title: Wine & Cheese
ideas.blurb: Burgundy wine glass tunic for one, yellow cheese wedge with holes for the other.
ideas.why: Grown-up funny, and it hands you a toast all night long.

ideas.title: Pop Star Demon Huntresses
ideas.blurb: Matching stage outfits, toy microphones, and demon-hunter poses for three.
ideas.why: Three matching looks and one shared pose make the group click instantly.

ideas.title: Goth Girl with Braids
ideas.blurb: Black dress, two tight braids, and a stare that ends conversations.
ideas.why: Two braids and a black dress: the most recognizable solo of the season for pocket change.

ideas.title: Juke-Joint Vampires
ideas.blurb: Sharp vintage suits, fangs, and a trumpet one of you never puts down.
ideas.why: Vintage suits plus fangs make the best-dressed scary couple in the room.

ideas.title: Blue Heeler Pup
ideas.blurb: Blue-gray hoodie, felt ears, and a painted nose for the littlest pup.
ideas.why: Toddlers already act like puppies, so this costume just agrees with them.

ideas.title: Baby Pumpkin
ideas.blurb: An orange onesie, green felt leaves, and the easiest first Halloween ever.
ideas.why: The canonical first costume: warm, soft, and finished in twenty minutes.

ideas.title: Pirate Captain
ideas.blurb: Striped shirt, cardboard captain hat, and a treasure map you drew yourself.
ideas.why: Closet clothes plus one cardboard hat, and the whole crew looks the part.

ideas.title: Cowboy and Cowgirl
ideas.blurb: Denim, cardboard hats, and bandanas for the pair that rides together.
ideas.why: Thrifted denim does the work, and matching cardboard hats make you a set.

ideas.title: S'mores Duo
ideas.blurb: Two graham-cracker tunics with a marshmallow and chocolate candy square between you.
ideas.why: Two crackers, one marshmallow, zero explanation needed at the door.

ideas.title: Friendly Scarecrow
ideas.blurb: Plaid shirt, straw poking out, and a stitched smile.
ideas.why: Straw in the sleeves and a painted smile: the friendliest scare on the block.

ideas.title: Yellow Henchmen Crew
ideas.blurb: Yellow shirts, blue overalls, and swim goggles for the whole crew.
ideas.why: One color scheme for everybody, and the goggles get laughs on sight.

ideas.title: Mystery-Solving Teens
ideas.blurb: Color-coded outfits, a toy magnifying glass, and one giant sandwich.
ideas.why: Everyone dresses from their own closet in one assigned color, and it clicks.

ideas.title: Pumpkin Groom and Patchwork Bride
ideas.blurb: Pinstripe suit and pumpkin mask for one, patchwork dress and yarn hair for the other.
ideas.why: Spooky-romantic and readable from far away, with thrifted pieces doing the lifting.

ideas.title: Moonwalking Pop Star
ideas.blurb: Red jacket, one glitter glove, and the lean everyone attempts.
ideas.why: Nail the lean and the moonwalk and strangers will request songs all night.

ideas.title: Witchy Sister Trio
ideas.blurb: Three color-coded witch dresses: green, purple, and orange.
ideas.why: Each picks a color and cackles in harmony; trios out-photograph duos.

ideas.title: Macabre Goth Couple
ideas.blurb: Long black gown and calm stare for one, sharp suit for the other.
ideas.why: The gothic couples standard: elegant, eerie, and almost entirely thrifted.

ideas.title: Party Pinata
ideas.blurb: A cardboard box wrapped in rainbow fringe, with real candy inside.
ideas.why: You hand out candy from inside the costume, which wins every single party.

ideas.title: Fuzzy Gremlin Plush
ideas.blurb: A furry brown onesie, big felt ears, and googly eyes.
ideas.why: The viral plush as a toddler costume: soft, warm, and extremely huggable.

ideas.title: Rescue Pup Team
ideas.blurb: Color-coded pup vests and felt ears for the whole preschool crew.
ideas.why: Each kid picks a color, and the team photo looks straight off the show.

ideas.title: Wayfinder Princess
ideas.blurb: A printed sailcloth top, grass skirt, and a cardboard hook.
ideas.why: The accuracy favorite: the shell necklace and hook make it unmistakable.

ideas.title: Chill Painter with Fro
ideas.blurb: A big brown afro wig, denim shirt, and a palette you painted yourself.
ideas.why: The happiest costume in the room, and everyone asks for a photo with the painter.
